valid_owner_sig_observed.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derived.meaning: an observer derived a high-s counterpart (s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1) recovering the identical signer address from the valid owner signature

try_recover_invalid_signature_s.meaning: OpenZeppelin ECDSA.tryRecover returns RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS for the high-s signature
try_recover_invalid_signature_s.checkpoint: during signature validation of the griefing UserOp

bundle_revert_occurred.meaning: the revert propagates through the entire bundle, causing the bundler's transaction to fail on-chain and lose gas
bundle_revert_occurred.checkpoint: after handleOps execution of the griefing UserOp

claims.scope: ERC-4337 UserOp signature validation in AtomWallet._validateSignature

preconditions.text: A valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after any executed UserOp.; From a valid owner signature an observer can derive a high-s counterpart with s' = curve_order - s and v' = v XOR 1, recovering the identical signer address.; A high-s signature causes OpenZeppelin ECDSA.tryRecover to return RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Signature validation should return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting on signature mismatch, including high-s signatures, so a single invalid signature cannot revert the whole bundle.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The revert propagates through the entire bundle, causing the bundler's transaction to fail on-chain and lose gas.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The griefing UserOp carrying the derived high-s signature is submitted to an AtomWallet via the EntryPoint handleOps path.
The EntryPoint calls AtomWallet.validateUserOp without a try/catch, so a revert in validation propagates to the bundle.
The high-s signature is a 65-byte signature accepted by the wallet's byte-format check before ECDSA recovery.

limitations: Formalizes only the bundle_revert_gas_loss impact; bundler compute waste and wallet degradation are separate impacts not covered here.
The condition encodes the concrete high-s griefing scenario rather than the fully general 'any signature mismatch' scope, because the report only grounds the high-s subcase.
